purpose: Contract for the north-star gap closure loop. The loop reads deterministic artifacts, classifies remaining gaps, writes resumable state/summary, and routes the next bounded workstream. It is candidate evidence, not proof of completion.
loop_rules: Refresh code inventory before classifying gaps when files changed.
Work one bounded next_gap at a time.
Keep proof gate green after each implementation cycle.
Do not run unsafe repo-wide rename sweeps.
Do not promote LLM output or placeholder/synthetic primitive rows as truth.
Mark unresolved dynamic refs instead of pretending they are resolved.
Preserve enterprise control paths: source export, package/private-service/API modes, BYOK, SBOM/provenance, rollback.
completion_law: Complete only when every tracked gap is ready_or_green, line/code inventory and hybrid packets are refreshed, primitive registry builder and promotion gate exist, and scripts/run_proofs.py is green.
